definition: Seeing AI is an artificial intelligence application developed by Microsoft for iOS.
details: Seeing AI uses the device camera to identify people and objects, and then the app audibly describes those objects for visually impaired people.

explainer.lead: Seeing AI is an artificial intelligence application developed by Microsoft for iOS. It matters because it turns the device camera into an audible description of the surroundings for visually impaired people.

tiers.eli5: Point your phone at something, and the app tells you out loud what it sees.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use the device camera to identify people and objects and have the app describe them audibly. A pitfall is that usefulness depends on recognition accuracy in real-world conditions.
tiers.paperLevel: Seeing AI is a Microsoft application for iOS that uses the device camera to identify people and objects and audibly describes those objects for visually impaired users.

explainer.example: A user points an iPhone at a person or object, and the app speaks a description of what the camera sees.
